Pakistani batters set cricket record with zero runs and wickets in 5 overs

In a cricket match, Pakistani batters achieved a unique record by scoring zero runs across five overs while losing a wicket in each of those overs. This unprecedented event marks the first time in 150 years of cricket that such a feat has occurred. The performance involved Justin Greaves, who took five wickets in five overs without conceding any runs.
